# `fjc_appointments`

**FJC appointment and reassignment observations**

FJC appointment and reassignment observations with exact retained FJC source evidence.

**Coverage.** Not a range. Each selected complete FJC Article III flat export retains its native judge population and repeated service groups, including listed historical courts and recess appointees. Acquisition time identifies an observation, not a frozen publisher revision. Other federal judges and vacancy histories are outside this export. Earlier observations survive only when selected together or retained in prior generations. Missing later rows do not prove deletion; cross-source identities remain unresolved. *(measured 2026-11-13)*

- **Parquet file:** `fjc_appointments.parquet`
- **MCP `query_sql` support:** Configured; requires an available artifact.
- **Publication status:** Not established by this schema page or its measurement date.
- **Row count:** Not stated here; the MCP `describe_table` reply gives the live count under `publication`.

| Column | Type | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `snapshot_id` | `VARCHAR` | Exact admitted source-release digest; include it in every join to keep observations separate. |
| `nid` | `VARCHAR` | Literal FJC Node ID, the native judge identifier; distinct from legacy jid and external judge IDs. |
| `source_record_id` | `VARCHAR` | Positional source-record identity in the admitted release. |
| `source_locator_json` | `VARCHAR` | Original URL, response SHA-256, byte size, acquisition time, CSV record number and exact byte span. Byte offsets are zero based; CSV record numbers include the header. |
| `service_ordinal` | `INTEGER` | Source service-group suffix; repeated terms and multiple commissions remain separate, including on the same court. |
| `appointment_id` | `VARCHAR` | FJC nid and source service-group suffix, scoped by snapshot_id. Identifies an observation of appointment or reassignment, not an independently proven cross-snapshot commission identity. |
| `appointment_kind` | `VARCHAR` | presidential-appointment, reassignment, assignment or unresolved, from the literal Appointing President. Reassignment never inherits a president from another group. |
| `court_label_id` | `VARCHAR` | SHA-256 key of the exact FJC court-type and court-name pair. A label key, not a proven cross-source court identity; join with snapshot_id. |
| `seat_id_raw` | `VARCHAR` | Literal FJC Seat ID identifying court, seat and succession order; not a vacancy identifier. |
| `appointment_title_raw` | `VARCHAR` | Literal FJC Appointment Title; empty strings and whitespace remain. |
| `appointing_president_raw` | `VARCHAR` | Literal FJC Appointing President; empty strings and whitespace remain. |
| `appointing_president_party_raw` | `VARCHAR` | Literal FJC Party of Appointing President; empty strings and whitespace remain. This is the president's party, not the judge's affiliation. |
| `reappointing_president_raw` | `VARCHAR` | Literal FJC Reappointing President; empty strings and whitespace remain. |
| `reappointing_president_party_raw` | `VARCHAR` | Literal FJC Party of Reappointing President; empty strings and whitespace remain. This is the reappointing president's party, not the judge's affiliation. |
| `aba_rating_raw` | `VARCHAR` | Literal FJC ABA Rating; empty strings and whitespace remain. |
| `new_seat_statute_raw` | `VARCHAR` | Literal FJC Statute Authorizing New Seat; empty strings and whitespace remain. |
| `committee_action_raw` | `VARCHAR` | Literal FJC Judiciary Committee Action; empty strings and whitespace remain. |
| `senate_vote_type_raw` | `VARCHAR` | Literal FJC Senate Vote Type; empty strings and whitespace remain. Voice votes are never assigned numeric shares. |
| `ayes_nays_raw` | `VARCHAR` | Literal FJC Ayes/Nays; empty strings and whitespace remain. No vote share is inferred; blank voice-vote counts remain blank. |
| `recess_appointment_date` | `DATE` | Full native Recess Appointment Date, if parseable as YYYY-MM-DD or MM/DD/YYYY; otherwise NULL with explicit date status and original string retained. |
| `nomination_date` | `DATE` | Full native Nomination Date, if parseable as YYYY-MM-DD or MM/DD/YYYY; otherwise NULL with explicit date status and original string retained. |
| `committee_referral_date` | `DATE` | Full native Committee Referral Date, if parseable as YYYY-MM-DD or MM/DD/YYYY; otherwise NULL with explicit date status and original string retained. |
| `hearing_date` | `DATE` | Full native Hearing Date, if parseable as YYYY-MM-DD or MM/DD/YYYY; otherwise NULL with explicit date status and original string retained. |
| `committee_action_date` | `DATE` | Full native Committee Action Date, if parseable as YYYY-MM-DD or MM/DD/YYYY; otherwise NULL with explicit date status and original string retained. |
| `confirmation_date` | `DATE` | Full native Confirmation Date, if parseable as YYYY-MM-DD or MM/DD/YYYY; otherwise NULL with explicit date status and original string retained. |
| `commission_date` | `DATE` | Full native Commission Date, if parseable as YYYY-MM-DD or MM/DD/YYYY; otherwise NULL with explicit date status and original string retained. |
| `date_status_json` | `VARCHAR` | Status of each typed date: full-date, empty, whitespace or unresolved-literal. Invalid and partial dates remain verbatim in the raw JSON. |
| `raw_appointment_json` | `VARCHAR` | Complete literal service group, preserving all original dates, vote text, party fields, blanks and unknown values. |
